segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hey Dana, thanks for making time. I wanted to confirm the last two items before kickoff Monday: 38 seats, annual billing, and July 22 as the target go-live.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, those are right. The only reason I grabbed you is the onboarding note I got this morning. It lists the import as customers and open invoices only.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Okay, yeah, I’m looking at the order now. For Harbor, it should be customers, open invoices, and the product catalog.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That’s what we agreed. The catalog is the big one. It’s 1,840 SKUs, and our ops team is counting on that being in before user testing starts July 8.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. I’ll have the onboarding agenda corrected today so Monday’s session covers the catalog file format and timing.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Appreciate it. I just don’t want to get on the kickoff and hear it’s phase two or an extra services item.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No, it’s included at no charge in the first-year package. Same total: $48,600 for the year, net 30 from the invoice date.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. And the invoice still goes to ap at harborwest dot com with the PO number in the header?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, PO 4172 in the header. I’ll send you the revised kickoff agenda by 3 Central.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. If that shows catalog import on it, we’re all set.
